app.name: Maitri
app.tagline: A friend who tells the family what to do now
common.audio_missing: Audio is not available. Please read the screen.
lang.title: Choose your language
mode.title: Who is using Maitri?
mode.woman: I am pregnant or a new mother
mode.asha: I am an ASHA or ANM
stage.title: Where are you now?
question.intro_woman: Answer for yourself. Tap Yes, No or Not sure.
question.intro_asha: Ask the woman, then tap her answer.
question.intro_family: Answer for her. Tap Yes, No or Not sure.
result.RED.title: Go to the hospital now
result.RED.title_family: She needs to go to the hospital now
result.RED.body: Call {number} for an ambulance. Do not wait to see if it gets better.
result.AMBER.title: See the ANM, ASHA or doctor today
result.AMBER.title_family: She needs to see the ANM, ASHA or doctor today
result.AMBER.body: Do not wait until tomorrow. If she feels worse, go to the hospital and call {number}.
result.GREEN.title: No danger sign told
result.GREEN.body: If she feels worse or you are worried, go to the health centre. Keep your regular check-ups.
result.not_sure_note: You were not sure about some answers. We treat 'not sure' with care.
result.show_slip: Show this to the ASHA or doctor
result.disclaimer_short: Maitri is an education tool. It does not diagnose. It cannot replace a health worker.
plan.title: Go-now plan
plan.step2: Ask who will go with her. Keep the MCP card and any medical papers ready.
plan.step3: Show the Maitri slip to the ambulance team or the hospital.
plan.step4: Ask about free transport and care. Government hospitals provide these under JSSK.
plan.transport_line: Free transport for pregnant women: call {number}
slip.title: Maitri slip
slip.footer: Made by Maitri. Education tool, not a diagnosis. No name or phone number is stored on this slip.
slip.share: Share a picture of this slip
wellbeing.title: You are not alone
wellbeing.body: Feeling very sad after birth is common and it can be treated. Please tell your ASHA, ANM or doctor today.
wellbeing.danger: If anyone is in danger right now, call {number}.
safety.title: About Maitri
safety.not_diagnosis: Maitri does not diagnose. It checks for danger signs and tells you how fast to get help.
safety.tiers_ours: The three result levels are our own design, based on the MoHFW MCP card and WHO guidance. They are not an official scheme.
safety.never_fine: Maitri never says someone is fine. If you are worried, go to a health centre.
safety.no_data: No name, phone number or account. Answers stay on this phone. Tap Clear this check to remove them.
safety.draft: The rules are a draft and have not been reviewed by a doctor yet.
trust.title: How Maitri decides
asha.list_empty: No checks yet. Start a check to see it here.
asha.list_note: Saved only on this phone. No names.
review.title: Rule review
error.generic: Something went wrong. Tap Check again. If it keeps happening, go to a health centre if you are worried.
slip.share_error: Could not make a picture. Tap Print this slip instead.
trust.tests_note: These tests check that the app follows the rule table. They are not clinical validation.
trust.numbers_note: Numbers marked not confirmed were given by the team. Check them locally before use.
asha.save_help: Off by default. Saves only stage and result. No names.
review.note: For the clinician. Nothing here is saved. Export gives a new rules file.
review.name_missing: Type the reviewer's name for every rule you ticked.
review.none_ticked: Tick at least one rule before exporting.
error.not_found: This page does not exist. Tap Go to start.
result.wellbeing_card: Support is available. Tap to see how.
result.go_worse: If she gets worse, go to the hospital and call {number}.
proto.banner: Prototype. Not reviewed by a doctor. Not for real use.
voice.title: Tell us what is happening
voice.hint: Tap the big button and speak. Tap it again when you finish.
voice.nothing: We did not hear anything. Tap the button and try again, or use the tap check.
voice.signs_title: Signs we found. Remove any that are wrong.
voice.no_signs: We did not find a danger sign in what you said. We will ask a few questions.
voice.unsupported: Voice is not available in this browser. Use Chrome on Android, or use the tap check.
voice.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow the microphone for this site, or use the tap check.
voice.network: Voice needs internet on most phones. Check your connection, or use the tap check.
voice.error: Voice did not work. Try again, or use the tap check.
voice.privacy: Your phone's browser turns your voice into text and may send it to its speech service. Maitri does not keep your voice or your words.
voice.say_answer: Say yes, no, or not sure.
voice.not_understood: We did not understand. Say yes or no, or tap a button.
account.title: Your account
account.not_configured: Accounts are not turned on in this version. The emergency check works without an account.
account.phone_hint: 10 digits. We send a code by text message.
account.code_sent: We sent a code to the number ending {last4}.
account.delete_body: This deletes your daily log and your sign-in. It cannot be undone.
account.privacy: We store the date, your answers and the result. The sign-in service holds your number or Google email to sign you in. Exit now signs you out on this phone.
account.error.bad_phone: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
account.error.bad_code: That code did not work. Check it and try again, or ask for a new code.
account.error.too_many: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
account.error.network: No internet. Check your connection and try again. The emergency check still works.
account.error.other: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
log.title: My daily log
log.empty: No entries yet. Do a check-in, then tap Save to my daily log.
log.error: Could not load your log. Check your internet and try again.
log.saved: Saved for today. Saving again today replaces this entry.
log.save_error: Could not save. Check your internet and try again.
log.signin_prompt: Sign in to keep a daily log
log.disclaimer: A log is not a diagnosis. If you feel worse, go to a health centre.
account.error.google_off: Google sign-in is not turned on yet. Use the phone code, or ask the project owner to turn it on.
